app.notes: v0.2.0 polish pass. Pipeline, guards and gateway client are BYTE-IDENTICAL to v1 (verified: git diff HEAD is empty for api/roast/route.ts, pipeline.ts, ssrf.ts, ratelimit.ts, cache.ts, spend.ts, gateway.ts, fetchPage.ts, extract.ts, roast.ts, score.ts, types.ts, url.ts). The result JSON contract is unchanged: no field added, removed or renamed. WHAT CHANGED, by WOW item. (1) REVEAL: the score dial sweeps 0 -> score while the number counts up on a matched easing curve, colour-graded by band; sub-scores stagger in (bar fills via scaleX, reason fades); roast lines deliver one by one; the verdict is now a hero line on the card. Every keyframe touches only transform/opacity/stroke-dashoffset, and all of it is off under prefers-reduced-motion. (2) DESIGN: one dark identity across home, loading and result; bigger expressive type; the loading state is now a pulsing dial skeleton with rotating copy and it scrolls itself into view. (3) SHARE CARD: the on-page card and /api/og were redesigned to the same design - favicon, site name, giant dial, verdict, best roast line, before -> after, and the roast.lightslips.ai wordmark on both, so every screenshot and every link preview carries the brand. The OG dial is now a real SVG arc (Satori renders it correctly - verified by rendering and eyeballing the PNG for all 9 cached results across every colour band). (4) VIRAL LOOP: one-tap Share on X with a prefilled tweet built in src/lib/share.ts (score + quoted teaser + the /r/<id> link, budgeted so the 280 limit holds with X's 23-char link count); Copy link; and Roast another -> in the share bar, in a closing CTA block, and in the header of a shared card. Clicking it resets in place rather than reloading. ALSO: someone arriving on a shared /r/<id> link used to land on the pitch with the card below the fold, so the whole reveal played off-screen. A shared arrival now gets a compact header and the card first. NEW FILES: src/lib/share.ts (tweet/teaser/quoteWrap, pure), src/lib/counter.ts (real cache count), src/lib/favicon.ts (inlines the favicon for the OG image). COUNTER IS REAL: it counts live files in .cache/results, nothing invented. It is hidden below MIN_DISPLAY=25 so a low-but-true number does not read as a dead launch - it is currently hidden (9 cached results). ONE JUDGEMENT CALL TO REVIEW: the OG image needs the favicon inlined because Satori cannot fetch images itself, and that URL comes off a page a stranger asked us to roast. src/lib/favicon.ts therefore reuses the EXISTING assertFetchableUrl guard (read-only, not modified), forbids redirects outright, and caps it at a 1.2s timeout / 192KB / allow-listed raster MIME types, with an in-memory memo. Every failure returns a monogram tile, never a broken preview - confirmed live on stripe.com, which falls back, while anthropic.com, google.com and cal.com inline their real icons. SMOKE-TESTED on a temp port 3098 only (pm2 `roast` on 3042 was never touched: same pid, 0 restarts, still 200 throughout). Verified in a headless browser at 414px: home, a live end-to-end fresh roast of cal.com (loading copy -> reveal -> card -> URL rewritten to /r/<id>), a mid-reveal frame at 430ms confirming the stagger actually staggers, and a shared-link arrival. Verified by curl: all pages 200, OG 200 image/png in ~0.56s, og:/twitter: tags absolute on roast.lightslips.ai, and the SSRF guard still refusing 169.254.169.254 and file:// unchanged. 244 unit tests pass (212 existing + 32 new for the share-intent builder, quoteWrap, the real counter and the score -> colour bands), typecheck clean, npm audit 0 vulnerabilities, npm run build clean. ORCHESTRATOR: .next is rebuilt in place; pm2 restart roast is yours to run, and is required for any of this to go live.
